jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer with React & Team Lead
jobs.facts: Dedication: It’s a full-time position (8 hours, 5 days a week) and fully remote (preferably if you are in a time zone ranging from GMT -7 to GMT +2 ). | The Agile Monkeys way: You will be part of our team and, therefore, will take advantage of all of our perks : technical workshops and presentations, mentoring, and coaching sessions, among others. | About the Role At The Agile Monkeys , we’re looking for a Senior React Developer who’s ready to go beyond coding and step up as a team lead . | This role is ideal for someone who not only has deep React expertise but also loves mentoring others, coordinating teams, and ensuring project success . | What is required in terms of APTITUDE: At least 8
